newsitem.title: POLAND: Drosed ups 1996 net profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Drosed ups 1996 net profit forecast.

text.p: Polish poultry producer Drosed SA raised its 1996 net profit forecast to 5.2 million zlotys for 1996, up from earlier expected 4.7 million, but down from last year's 6.1 million, Drosed's financial director said.
Zbigniew Nasilowski told Reuters the company expected its net profit to grow to 8.6 million zlotys in 1997.

"Our net profit this year will be lower than last year's because of the modernisation of our plant in Torun, but we should soon start benefitting from that and our net profit should grow to 8.56 million zlotys next year," he said.
